2610.06383.title: Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering
2610.06383.paper_summary: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.
2610.06383.paper_summary_zh: 推理時間的引導提供了對語言模型輸出的廉價、細緻控制，通過估計概念在激活空間中的表示並將激活向其移動。現有的方法是基於對比數據集的激活平均值來構建這些表示。這些平均值包含無關的概念和噪聲，並且被少數幾個標記主導，這意味著激活傳輸編碼的是標記級別而非主題概念。在這項工作中，我們引導向最能主題性表達概念的例子，而不是對所有例子的期望。我們使用影響函數來識別這些例子，這些函數估計每個數據點對模型概念表示的貢獻。與簡單的模型激活相似性不同，它們考慮了模型損失地形的曲率，使其能夠捕捉超越表面標記級別相似性的概念相關關係。我們然後提出影響加權的激活傳輸，這使用最優傳輸將非概念文本的激活引導到概念文本的激活上，並根據其影響分數加權概念例子。我們在毒性抑制（Jigsaw）、基於物體的概念引導（OneSec）和真實性引導（TruthfulQA）上進行評估，超越現有的激活傳輸基準。我們在引導後使用困惑度和MMLU準確度跟踪能力，發現我們的方法在大幅保留模型質量的同時改善了引導。我們進一步展示了影響函數捕捉了激活基礎方法所忽略的概念相關信息，這兩種方法對數據點的排名顯著不同。總體而言，這些結果展示了考慮曲率的影響信息對激活引導的價值。
